properties.rationale: Not a defect: cmp:scope was built after the last release cut on 2026-07-25, so "ships in nothing" is true and expected of anything newly built. Third instance of this shape today (cmp:docs, cmp:claims, cmp:sanitize before it), all resolving the same way — the next cut lists everything it actually ships, which the AGENTS.md release checklist already requires. Worth noting the pattern rather than acknowledging it a fourth time silently: a component built between releases will always raise this, so the finding is really a reminder that a release is owed, and it will clear itself the moment one is cut.
